purpose.description: Diagnostic separability analysis of frozen updater-pathway features.
purpose.role: Measure whether available interface features contain detectable differences between evaluated systems.

task.description: Classify future adaptation target class using only frozen CMI v0.2 observations.

label_access.interpretation: labels used only for diagnostic separability evaluation

overall.interpretation: chance-level separability under frozen interface observations

result.interpretation: future target divergence is hidden from interface

factorization_relevance.diagnostic_question: Does the observation contain target-relevant information?
factorization_relevance.formal_note: Classifier performance cannot exceed information available in O_CMI_v0.2.

decision.reason: AUC measures diagnostic separability, not factorization existence. The factorization gate failed due to observational equivalence.

notes: The chance-level result on adversarial pairs is expected and is the decisive diagnostic.
The perfect local mimic result demonstrates that the interface is not universally blind.
The failure occurs because target-relevant distinctions can remain outside the observation map.
